Payments has 14 absences logged against a usual 2.6 per day (11 late because of a bus strike, 3 sick). General has 8 against a usual 2.4 (5 late because of the bus strike, 3 sick). Both queues are running about 6–7 agents below plan every interval (payments 25 vs 32, general 22 vs 29 at 09:30), but volume today is in line with forecast (payments -3.0%, general +0.9%) and handle times are mostly at or below forecast, so this is a capacity problem, not extra demand.
